## Products

### NOICE Lab Magnesium Glycinate (SKU NL-MG-30)

- Pack: 30 capsules
- What's inside: Magnesium bisglycinate 200 mg (at least 100 mg elemental magnesium, chelated); L-theanine 10 mg; Vitamin B6 4 mg; Piperine. Transparent capsule with coloured beadlets.
- How to use: 1 capsule once daily. [Best time, e.g. evening or with food: per label, placeholder]. Follow the directions on the pack.
- Precautions: Consult a doctor before use if on medication or if you have a kidney condition. Contains magnesium, chamomile extract and piperine: check with a doctor or pharmacist if you take other magnesium or B6 supplements or any regular medicine. Chamomile can trigger reactions in people allergic to related plants such as ragweed. Do not exceed the stated serving.
- Sugar and diet: [Veg / gluten-free / allergen claims: per label, placeholder]
- Storage: [Cool, dry place below 25-30 C, away from sunlight, cap tightly closed, out of reach of children. Shelf life X months: placeholder]

### NOICE Lab Hydration Electrolyte, Orange (SKU NL-HE-OR-10)

- Pack: 10 sachets
- What's inside: Per sachet (for 500 ml): Sodium 200 mg (pink salt); Potassium 200 mg (potassium chloride); Magnesium 200 mg (magnesium bisglycinate); Calcium 200 mg (calcium lactate); Zinc 200 mg (zinc bisglycinate); Vitamin C 200 mg. Also orange flavour, citric acid, [stevia / sucralose], natural colours (yellow and purple carrot).
- How to use: Mix 1 sachet (5.3 g) in 500 ml water and stir until dissolved. [When to drink and max sachets per day: per label, placeholder]
- Precautions: Consult a doctor if you have a medical condition or take regular medication, including blood pressure medicines. Each sachet has 200 mg sodium and 200 mg potassium: people with high blood pressure, kidney or heart conditions, or on a salt- or potassium-restricted diet should consult a doctor first. Do not exceed the recommended sachets per day.
- Sugar and diet: [No added sugar, if confirmed: placeholder]. Sweetened with [stevia / sucralose]. [Calories per sachet: X kcal]
- Storage: [Cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture. Once mixed, drink within X hours. Shelf life X months: placeholder] Keep out of reach of children.
- Questions people often ask next:
  - Who should avoid it?
  - Is it sugar-free?
  - How much sodium is that?

  - Is it safe during pregnancy?
